Copies per-element buffer data between source and destination arrays using an interleaved offset pattern: for each of the this+0x20 elements computes a scaled copy size from the element descriptors (descriptor value at this+0xD0 times the value at this+0xE8 divided by the stride this+0x114), then copies blocks backward and forward across stride positions to mirror each element across adjacent slots, using the source array at this+0x1B8 and the destination array at this+0x1BC indexed by element. Returns the final element index. Called only from AudioStreamBufferFill (0x00519720).

Streaming buffer filler driven by a three-state machine at this+0x1C4 (flattened descriptor +0x44): state 0 schedules a new write window, state 1 performs the write dispatch, state 2 flushes. On first use the descriptor init flag (this+0x1B0) is clear, so an indirect setup call through this+0x184+12 primes the channel and increments the write-cycle counter this+0x1CC. Writes dispatch through an indirect call at this+0x188+4 with the fill position (this+0x1B4) and the write target (this+0x1C8). When a write window completes the channel buffer index this+0x1C0 toggles with XOR 1, PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset (0x0051954E) runs when the cycle counter equals 1, ArrayProcessingWithScaling (0x00519622) runs when the cycle counter reaches the limit this+0x118, and the state advances to flush.

transitions.condition: ParseIhdrChunk sets bit 0 of the flags word at +0x58 after validating the IHDR payload.
PNGPLTEChunkParser sets the PLTE-seen bit in the flags word at +0x58.
gAMA/sRGB/tRNS parsers gate on the IDAT-seen bit (bit 2) to reject chunks arriving after image data.
Schedule path: fill position (+0x1B4) set to 0, write target (+0x1C8) set to this+0x114 - 1, state (+0x1C4) set to 1.
Write window completes: channel buffer index (+0x1C0) toggled with XOR 1, PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset (0x0051954E) runs when the cycle counter (+0x1CC) equals 1, state set to 2.
Flush completes when the fill position (+0x1B4) reaches the write target (+0x1C8); state returns to 0 and the schedule path runs again while the output counter is below its limit.

compatibility_contracts.name: PngDecoderStateAndOrderingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A PNG decoder object tracks chunk ordering in a flags word at +0x58 (bit 0 IHDR seen, bit 1 PLTE seen, bit 2 IDAT seen) and auxiliary flags in the byte at +0x5D (bit 0x10 palette active, bit 0x20 palette-alpha buffer). A replacement decoder must preserve this ordering contract and the +0x58/+0x5D flag layout.
